research_question: A parita di contesto recuperato, come varia la capacita di produrre una risposta corretta e supportata al variare del modello generativo?

excluded_claims: general ranking of the two model families
handling of obsolete or updated facts

split.rule: episode number, fixed before model execution

development.use: prompt, parser, runtime and cost checks only; excluded from final results

sufficient.target_evidence: include the exact field value block for the requested case
sufficient.distractors: include one deterministic block for each of the other two cases
sufficient.expected_behavior: return all and only the target values

insufficient.target_evidence: omit every block for the requested case
insufficient.distractors: use exactly the same two other-case blocks as in sufficient

context_builder.distractor_rule: For each other case, use the queried field when present; otherwise use the lexicographically first available field.
context_builder.ordering_rule: Sort all included blocks by SHA-256 of builder_seed + ':' + question_id + ':' + case_alias.

prompt.system: Usa esclusivamente le informazioni presenti in CONTEXT. Le etichette Caso A, Caso B e Caso C identificano casi distinti. Non usare conoscenze pregresse. Restituisci tutti e soli i valori riportati esplicitamente per il caso e il campo richiesti, conservandone la grafia. Se l'informazione richiesta non e presente, restituisci una lista vuota. Restituisci soltanto un oggetto JSON conforme allo schema richiesto.

runtime.format: use prompt.response_schema as the Ollama format value
runtime.note: One deterministic generation per cell is not a replication. Internal templates and tokenization remain model-specific.

primary_metrics.sufficient_exact_match_rate: predicted normalized set equals expected set

secondary_metrics.unsupported_value_rate: any value outside the expected set; any non-empty value in insufficient
secondary_metrics.cross_case_intrusion_rate: wrong values matching another case in the episode; report only on detectable subset
secondary_metrics.format_error_rate: raw output cannot be validated against the response schema

evaluation.independence_rule: The episode is the resampling unit; nine questions from one episode are not nine independent replications.
evaluation.forbidden_aggregation: Do not combine sufficient and insufficient into one score and do not average SC06 with SC01-SC05.

summaries: generated tokens per second from eval_count/eval_duration
performance.memory_proxy: Record size and size_vram from Ollama /api/ps once after loading each model.
performance.limitation: Ollama size_vram is an allocation reported by the runtime, not measured peak RAM; do not present it as peak memory consumption.

execution_gates: Build requests and oracle as separate files.
Validate hashes, split counts, prompt leakage, block ordering and expected call counts offline.
Run development split only and inspect failures before freezing implementation version.
Do not change prompt, context builder, model tags, options or evaluator after starting evaluation; create a new config_id if a change is required.
Preserve every raw request, raw response, error and runtime metadata; support resume without duplicating completed cells.
